t: Advisors declare data sources, assess adequacy, and create lugs to fill gaps — self-improving data pipelines
description: Each advisor (Historian, Lathe, Compass, Distribor, Gardener) should understand its own data sources. If a source is inadequate — missing fields, stale, insufficient coverage — the advisor can dictate new lugs requesting better instrumentation from its team. This makes advisors self-improving: they don't just consume data, they shape their own inputs.
perceive: Advisors currently read whatever data exists. They have no mechanism to say 'I need field X on lugs to do my job better' or 'the track format is missing Y for my analysis'. Each advisor should own a data_sources declaration listing what it reads, what it needs, and what's missing.
execute: 1. Define advisor data_sources schema: {source, path, fields_used, fields_needed, adequacy_score, gap_lugs[]}
2. Add data_sources declaration to each advisor config (historian scan_state.json, lathe config, compass config, etc.)
3. Add adequacy check at advisor activation — if score < threshold, auto-create gap lug requesting better data
4. Gap lugs route to the team responsible for the data source (e.g., 'track schema needs X field' → framework task)
5. Teaching candidate: distribute as protocol for all spoke advisors
verify: Each advisor has data_sources declaration. Adequacy check runs at activation. Gap lugs created when data is insufficient. At least one real gap identified and addressed.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Self-improving advisor data pipeline — advisors shape their own inputs, not just consume them
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not advisors writing code or modifying schemas directly. They REQUEST better data via lugs. Humans/agents decide whether to fulfill.
